enabled.name: Enable distance label
enabled.hint: Show a distance label whenever you hover over a token.

combatOnly.name: Only during combat
combatOnly.hint: Show distance labels only while a combat is active (started).

altShowAll.name: Hold Alt to show all distances
altShowAll.hint: While holding the "Highlight Objects" key (Alt by default), show distances from your selected tokens to every visible token. Requires at least one selected token; without a selection it does nothing.

precision.name: Decimal precision
precision.hint: How precisely to display the distance value.

unit.name: Unit suffix
unit.hint: Text appended after the number, with a space automatically added between them (e.g. "6.5 in"). Use whatever unit your system/table uses (in, ft, m, squares, etc.).

sizeMode.name: Label size mode
sizeMode.hint: Static: the label keeps a fixed size in scene units (bigger when you zoom in). Adaptive: the label keeps a constant size on screen regardless of zoom level or your distance from the scene.

anchor.name: Label position
anchor.hint: Where the label sits relative to the token. "Above the token" / "Below the token" place it at the token's top / bottom edge; the offset below then pushes it away from that edge. "On the token center" puts it exactly in the middle (offset ignored).

offset.name: Offset from token edge (pixels)
offset.hint: Distance, in pixels, between the token's top or bottom edge and the label, in the direction chosen above. Ignored when the position is "On the token center".

fontFamily.name: Font family
fontFamily.hint: Font used to draw the distance label (must be a font available/loaded in Foundry).

fontSize.name: Font size
fontSize.hint: Size, in pixels, of the distance label text.

fontBold.name: Bold text
fontBold.hint: Draw the distance label in bold.

fontColor.name: Font color
fontColor.hint: Color of the label text. Use the picker to sample a color, including directly off your screen.

strokeColor.name: Outline color
strokeColor.hint: Color of the label's outline. Use the picker to sample a color, including directly off your screen.

strokeWidth.name: Outline thickness
strokeWidth.hint: Thickness, in pixels, of the text outline. Set to 0 to disable the outline entirely.

badgeEnabled.name: Show background badge
badgeEnabled.hint: Draw a rounded background panel behind the distance text, instead of plain floating numbers.

badgeColor.name: Badge color
badgeColor.hint: Fill color of the background badge behind the text.

badgeOpacity.name: Badge opacity (%)
badgeOpacity.hint: Opacity of the background badge, from fully transparent (0) to fully opaque (100).

badgePadding.name: Badge width (side padding, px)
badgePadding.hint: Horizontal space between the text and the badge's left/right edges. Lower it for a narrower badge, raise it for a wider one.

enforceGMStyle.name: Apply GM style to all players
enforceGMStyle.hint: GM only. When enabled, every player automatically uses the GM's appearance settings (position, size, font, colors, badge) and their own copies of these settings become locked and uneditable. Behavior settings (combat-only, ALT mode) stay personal and are not affected.

settings.lockedByGM: Locked: the GM has enforced this setting for all players.
